items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
One (1) year experience working in a fast-paced Primary Care clinic.
Experience with vaccine administration, venipuncture, and point-of-care testing (POCT).
Experience with EPIC and Cadence modules.
One (1) year of Ambulatory Care, Primary Care, Express, or Urgent Care experience.

Under direct supervision of the clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers and licensed nursing staff, performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within business and profession's code of the State of California and/or the regulations of The Joint Commission (TJC).

These duties also include but are not limited to: scheduling of patient appointments and associated patient system screens, accurate billing, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management and cleaning/disinfecting the environment. Requires knowledge of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions and proper use of body mechanics. Position requires initiative, the ability to prioritize demands and the ability to work in a team environment. Other related duties as assigned.
Knowledge of medical terminology, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics.
Knowledge and understanding of FLOW process specific to UCSD community care.
Require initiative and the ability to prioritize demands.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, adapt to changing needs, and provide reliable support in a fast-paced clinical environment.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary care team.
